title: The Saieglow™ Bestsellers Kit
descriptionHtml:
✓ Without Silicones✓ Fragrance Free✓ Alcohol Free✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Long-wearing
What it is: A kit of bestselling SaieGlow essentials, featuring a mini lightweight illuminator, a full-size liquid-cream blush, and a mini setting spray.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Plant-Derived Glycerin: A powerful humectant that increases skin’s moisture level.
- Plant-Derived Squalane: An emollient that locks in moisture and leaves skin quenched.
- Hydrolyzed Corn Starch: Sets makeup with a flexible, comfortable feel on the skin.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Beginner- and travel-friendly, this kit has everything you need to create your very own Signature SaieGlow in style. Illuminate with Glowy Super Gel in Sunglow
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Illuminate and prep skin with Glowy Super Gel.
-Add a dewy wash of mauve color on cheeks with Dew Blush.
-Spray on CitySet Setting Spray to set your look for up to 16 hours.
Ingredients+
-Plant-Derived Glycerin: A powerful humectant that increases skin’s moisture level.
-Plant-Derived Squalane: An emollient that locks in moisture and leaves skin quenched.
-Hydrolyzed Corn Starch: Sets makeup with a flexible, comfortable feel on the skin.

Dew Blush in Chilly:
Isocetyl Stearoyl Stearate, Glycerin, Tribehenin, Sambucus Nigra (Elderberry) Fruit Extract, Mica, Glyceryl Stearate, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Silica, Morus Alba (White Mulberry) Root Extract, Symphytum Officinale (Comfrey) Leaf Extract, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Root Extract. [+/- May Contain/ Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide Ci77891, Iron Oxides (Ci77492, Ci77491, Ci77499), Yellow 6 Lake, Red 7 Lake, Red 22 Lake, Ferric Ferrocyanide].

Glowy Super Gel in Sunglow:
Water/Aqua/Eau, Caprylic/capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Glycerin, Mica, Sodium Acrylate/sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Caprylyl Glycol, Isohexadecane, Phenethyl Alcohol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Polysorbate 80, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Carica Papaya (Papaya) Seed Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Sorbitan Oleate, Lactic Acid, Tin Oxide, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499).

Mini CitySet:
Aqua/Water/Eau, Propanediol, Hydrolyzed Corn Starch, Pentylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Glycerin, Citric Acid, Citrus Reticulata (Tangerine) Peel Extract, Glycogen, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Sodium Hydroxide.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
